title: Map71 Crusader order event and Map70 return gate using visible max-level New Game

runtime.session: Fresh temporary browser profile. New Game and all gameplay actions used the visible UI and keyboard input.

setup.route: Visible New Game from Map64, replaying the Map63/Reah, Map19/22/24, Map25, Map10/11, Map63 follow-up, and Map69 flag-25 route documented in M887, then continuing through Map71.

interaction.action: Interact, then advance the visible event until it closes

observations.route: Map71 south marker return to Map70
observations.input: Press Down into the south marker after flag 81 is set

observations.interpretation: Map70 has positive marker-1 cells on its south-side floor. Since event resolution uses the absolute marker value, these cells can select the type-0 Map69 transfer script. This candidate exit was not live-tested in M888.

observations.route: Map70 marker -4 re-entry to Map71 and Map71 return repeat
observations.result: Visible movement reached Map71 [10,18] through the Map70 north marker; pressing Down returned to Map70 [9,5]. The event flags and order item remained present.

method.inputs: Visible keyboard movement, interaction, and dialogue advancement only; New Game was chosen from the title screen.
method.observation: Transient WorldScene state was read at visible route checkpoints. Screenshots show browser-rendered Map71/Map70 states and the Map70 door message.
method.restrictions: No in-game Save/Load, browser-storage read, local-save access, original-JAR access, direct map start, or gameplay-state seeding was used.

limits: This verifies the captured current-build Chromium route with the developer-only max-level profile; it does not establish ordinary-level survivability or J2ME parity.
The Map70 north-side door reports that it is locked. The positive marker-1 south exit is a candidate route to Map69, but M888 did not live-test it.
The run reaches the Map71 order event and repeats the Map71/Map70 return; it does not establish natural full-campaign completion or verify every map, event, ending, and Save/Load path.
